text:
leah: Heads up — nightly perf gate for the longseq-suite failed (job 45892). p99 latency ~35% higher than baseline on canary, CI turned red. Rerun queued but want a quick triage in case this is a flaky spike or infra issue.

ci-bot: [CI] Job 45892 — FAILED. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/45892/logs. Perf artifacts: https://ci.redwood.example/45892/artifacts. Rerun triggered: 45893.

jonathan: Can you paste the p99 / p95 numbers and the commit shas for baseline vs canary? Also which region was this run in?

leah: p95 ~120ms (unchanged), p99 went from 240ms -> 325ms. Baseline sha: abcdef123, canary sha: f0f1e2d3. Run was in us-west-2 canary pool.

maya: FWIW saw a similar blip in staging yesterday after a runtime deploy (2.3.x). Might be KV cache churn when many longseq requests hit the same model shards — p95 holds but tail moves.

paul: Quick thought: can we rerun with KV prewarm and tighter batch window to rule out batching jitter? e.g. `KV_CACHE_PREWARM=true` and `BATCHER_MAX_WINDOW_MS=10`. Sasha — can you trigger that variant?

sasha: happy to run a bisect if rerun still fails. I'll need the baseline/canary shas (got them) and perms for the loadgen cluster. I'll try the prewarm variant first.

leah: K, rerun 45893 is the default config. To run the variant use:
```
./scripts/ci/run_perf.sh --suite longseq --commit f0f1e2d3 --env canary --env-overrides KV_CACHE_PREWARM=1 BATCHER_MAX_WINDOW_MS=10
```
I can kick that off if someone confirms.

ops-bot: Notified infra oncall about increased tail latency in canary. infra oncall ping: @jonathan.

jonathan: I'll watch 45893. If it fails again I'll allocate a spare canary node pool and check kernel/hw metrics (CPU steal, NIC drops). If 45893 passes, we'll treat 45892 as flaky.

paul: :thumbsup: If 45893 passes with prewarm + tighter batch then we should add a short-term mitigation to the nightly gating config.

sasha: Starting a bisect job spanning commits abcdef123..f0f1e2d3 now (will post results in ~15m). If bisect narrows to a single runtime change I'll open a PR link + rollback proposal. :crossed_fingers: 

leah: Thanks. If bisect points to infra (kernel/driver) we escalate to infra team. Otherwise follow normal perf regression path. I'll update the gate ticket with IDs.
